description: React component for managing and displaying a list of variables, including search, pagination, add/edit/delete operations, and dialogs.

methods.name: Variables
methods.description: Main React component for variable management, including state, effects, and UI rendering.

methods.name: addNew
methods.description: Opens dialog to add a new variable.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Opens dialog to edit an existing variable.

methods.name: deleteVariable
methods.description: Deletes a variable after user confirmation, with snackbar notifications.

methods.name: onConfirm
methods.description: Handles confirmation after add/edit operations, refreshes data and cache.

methods.name: onChange
methods.description: Handles pagination page and limit changes.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Fetches variables data with current pagination parameters.

methods.name: onSearchChange
methods.description: Updates search state based on user input.

methods.name: filterVariables
methods.description: Filters variables based on search term.
